prompt: Ms. Ruiz measured her leftover ribbon pieces and made a line plot. The line plot shows: $\frac{1}{4}$ ft appears $2$ times, $\frac{1}{2}$ ft appears $3$ times, and $\frac{3}{4}$ ft appears $1$ time. What is the total length of ribbon, in feet? (Answer as a mixed number.)
hint: Handle one column at a time: how much ribbon do the two $\frac{1}{4}$-ft pieces make together?

hints.text: Handle one column at a time: how much ribbon do the two $\frac{1}{4}$-ft pieces make together?

alternativeExplanations.title: Count everything in fourths
steps: $\frac{1}{4}$ twice is $\frac{2}{4}$; $\frac{1}{2}$ is $\frac{2}{4}$, so three of them is $\frac{6}{4}$; and $\frac{3}{4}$ is $\frac{3}{4}$.
